scoring_justification: Recompute the critical island size selection from the simulated island densities against the experimental target. Structural check of monotonic density trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental AFM island density target (35 µm⁻²) used as hidden gold for recomputing the best matching i. The value is from the paper (AFM measurement for 0.03 ML coverage).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported value (AFM measurement) for coverage 0.03 ML, described in text and Fig. 15.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the actual experimental target used in the paper's KMC comparison; it is the correct hidden gold because the task requires matching the experimental density.

island_density_per_um2.description: final island density in islands per µm²

outputs.description: Island densities for each critical island size i, compared against hidden paper reference densities with tolerance.

schema.description: A single integer (3..8) representing the critical island size i that minimizes the difference between simulated and experimental island density.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the KMC simulation from scratch. The experimental AFM island density (35 µm⁻²) is provided as public input for the selection step. The hidden scoring checks both the island density trend (tolerance 25%) and the correctness of the selected critical island size.

steps.description: Structural check: correct entries for i=3..8 and island densities monotonically non-increasing with critical island size. A tolerance of 25% of the maximum density is used to allow for stochastic fluctuations in the KMC simulation.
Recompute the best i from island_density_vs_i.json against experimental density 35 µm⁻²; verify the agent's chosen i matches the recomputed best i and equals 7.
